responsibility: Provides the small public interface shared from the dominator optimization implementation, currently exposing helpers such as simple_iv_increment_p that other tree-SSA loop and propagation code uses to recognize increment patterns without depending on the full DOM pass internals.
same_name_distinction: This header provides only a minimal shared helper declaration, notably simple_iv_increment_p, for other tree-SSA code. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-dom.cc, it does not define the dominator optimization pass or its equivalence/availability algorithms.
